column2: Ensure FTP Server is not installed
Ensure telnet client is not installed
Ensure SSH MaxAuthTries is set to 4 or less
Ensure SSH Idle Timeout Interval is configured:ClientAliveInterval <= 300
Ensure SSH Idle Timeout Interval is configured:ClientAliveCountMax <= 3
Ensure SSH disabling direct root access
Ensure SSH allow the server SSH2 protocol only
Ensure SSH allow the client SSH2 protocol only
Ensure SSH host-based authentication is disallowed
